newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $2.9 bln for next week.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $2.9 bln for next week.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for next week were expected to total $2.9 billion in 102 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.9 billion in 37 sales, with a $482 million New York City offering through J.P. Morgan Securities Inc., topping the list.
On the competitive side, 65 sales totaling $1.041 billion are scheduled. A $217 million Orange County, Fla., offering on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional four sales totaling $357 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues next week depending on market conditions.
